shortDescription: French container shipping giant CMA CGM said it had signed a preliminary deal with China Communications Construction Company (CCCC) to expand cooperation in port infrastructure, logistics, transport services and lower-carbon supply chains.

children: French container shipping giant CMA CGM said it had signed a preliminary deal with China Communications Construction Company (CCCC) to expand cooperation in port infrastructure, logistics, transport services and lower-carbon supply chains.
The memorandum of understanding, signed in Shenzhen, would focus on Africa, China and Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Latin America, CMA CGM said in a statement.
The deal builds on an existing relationship between the two groups in several port projects, notably in Nigeria and Cameroon, through units including China Harbour Engineering Company, it said.
